description: This file contains the implementation of the InProcessTestCluster class, a core component used to initialize, manage, and manipulate in-process Orleans testing clusters, including starting/stopping silos and clients, configuring options, and handling cluster lifecycle events.

classes.name: InProcessTestCluster
classes.description: A class that manages the setup, lifecycle, and teardown of an in-process Orleans cluster for testing purposes, including starting/stopping silos and clients, configuring options, and handling cluster health and state.

methods.name: DeployAsync
methods.description: Initializes and deploys the in-process cluster, starting silos and optionally initializing the client.

methods.name: StartSiloAsync
methods.description: Starts a new silo instance within the cluster, based on specified options.

methods.name: InitializeClientAsync
methods.description: Initializes the cluster client to enable communication with silos.

methods.name: GetSiloServiceProvider
methods.description: Returns the service provider for a specified silo, or a random one if none specified.

methods.name: WaitForInitialStabilization
methods.description: Waits for the cluster to reach a stable state where all silos agree on membership.

methods.name: GetActiveSilos
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currently active silos.

methods.name: StopAllSilos
methods.description: Stops all silos and the cluster client.
